value.name: Asha stands and gathers her things
value.description: Asha finishes at her desk, picks up the folder with the Tuesday report, takes her coat, and moves toward the conference room door.
evidence: stood. She picked up the folder with the Tuesday report still face-down at the bottom, gathered her coat from the back of the chair, and crossed to the conference room door

value.name: Asha silently escorts Mrs. Hatcher
value.description: Asha holds the door open for Mrs. Hatcher and says nothing about the report or the phone message, maintaining a composed front.
evidence: holding it open for Mrs. Hatcher with the same neutral steadiness she had kept all morning, saying nothing about the line in the report or the message on her phone

value.name: Rosa deletes unsent message
value.description: Across town, Rosa opens her thread to Asha and deletes a half-typed message she had been carrying since the Whitfield meeting.
evidence: Across town, Rosa lifted her phone off the counter, opened the thread to Asha, and deleted without sending the half-typed message she had been carrying since the Whitfield meeting

value.name: Rosa sets phone aside and folds towel
value.description: Rosa puts her phone face-down on the counter and folds the towel over the sink edge, signaling restraint and withdrawal.
evidence: she set the phone face-down on the counter again and folded the towel over the edge of the sink

value.name: Asha guides Mrs. Hatcher to courtroom
value.description: In the corridor, Asha adjusts the folder under her arm and walks Mrs. Hatcher toward the courtroom door without speaking.
evidence: In the corridor outside the conference room, Asha shifted the folder under her arm so the weight of it sat against her ribs and walked Mrs. Hatcher toward the courtroom door without speaking

value.name: Asha pauses at courtroom door
value.description: At the courtroom door, Asha stops and takes a breath that feels incomplete, showing strain beneath her composure.
evidence: At the courtroom door Asha stopped, shifted the folder so the Tuesday report sat flat against her ribs, and took one breath that did not quite fill her chest

value.name: Rosa sends brief support message
value.description: Rosa types 'hold the line' to Asha and leaves the message unsent on the counter, implying a delayed but deliberate attempt to reach her.
evidence: Across town, Rosa picked up the phone, opened the thread, and typed hold the line, then set it face-down on the counter without waiting for anything back

value.name: Asha feels Rosa's message through folder
value.description: Asha senses the phone buzz through the folder instead of her pocket, refuses to look, and tightens her grip until it hurts.
evidence: Asha felt the buzz through the wood of the folder rather than her pocket and did not look; she tightened her grip until the cardstock edge pressed a thin line into the inside of her arm

value.name: Asha opens door for Mrs. Hatcher
value.description: After steadying herself, Asha places her free hand on the door and continues holding it for Mrs. Hatcher.
evidence: and only then did she put her free hand on the door for Mrs. Hatcher
